source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
A unit embarked in a **TRANSPORT** or in **strategic reserves** is off the battlefield:

- It is not **visible** to other units, and they are not visible to it; every unit is visible to itself.
- No distance can be measured to or from it, except for its own abilities.

So no attack or rule that needs a unit to be visible or within a distance can pick it, other than its own abilities.

It still uses its other rules, and as one of its controller’s units it can be picked by rules that choose one of an army’s units and is affected by rules for every unit in an army.

In each of their Command phases, its controller makes **battle-shock rolls** for it if it is **battle-shocked** or at **half-strength** or worse.
